async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Use the searchbox to filter for 'Pytorch GAN'
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name")
    await searchbox.fill("Pytorch GAN")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for filtering

    # Step 2: Find and click the Pytorch GAN project link
    # Look for heading containing 'Pytorch GAN' and get its link
    try:
        project_heading = page.get_by_role("heading", name="Pytorch GAN", exact=False)
        project_link = project_heading.get_by_role("link")
        await project_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    except Exception as e:
        # If not found, try to find any link with 'Pytorch GAN'
        project_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Pytorch GAN", exact=False)
        await project_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

    # Step 3: Navigate to the commits page
    # First, try to find a 'Repository' link
    try:
        repo_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Repository", exact=False)
        await repo_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    except Exception as e:
        pass

    # Then look for 'Commits' link
    try:
        commits_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Commits", exact=False)
        await commits_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    except Exception as e:
        # If not found, assume we are on a page with commit data
        pass

    # Step 4: Extract the top contributor's name
    # Look for a table with contributor data
    try:
        table = page.get_by_role("table")
        # Get the first data row (assuming header is first row)
        first_data_row = table.get_by_role("row").nth(1)
        # Get the first cell, which might contain the contributor name
        contributor_cell = first_data_row.get_by_role("cell").first
        top_contributor = await contributor_cell.text_content()
        print(top_contributor)
    except Exception as e:
        # If no table, look for list items
        try:
            list_items = page.get_by_role("listitem").all()
            if list_items:
                top_contributor = await list_items[0].text_content()
                print(top_contributor)
            else:
                # Fallback: print page title
                title = await page.title()
                print(title)
        except Exception as e2:
            title = await page.title()
            print(title)
